The association rules algorithm for a TCM constitution analysis based on in Hadoop framework(ARA-TCM) in machine learning is applied to the classification of TCM constitutions, and the corresponding classification model was established to observe the accuracy of category prediction and provide preliminary screening and decision support for TCM constitutions analysis. Meanwhile, the association rules algorithm for a TCM constitution analysis based on in Hadoop framework (ARA- TCM) is compared with the Apriori algorithm, and the results show that the association rules algorithm for a TCM constitution analysis based on in Hadoop framework (ARA-TCM) has better classification effect than the Apriori algorithm. This indicates that it is feasible to apply the association rules algorithm for a TCM constitution analysis based on in Hadoop framework (ARA- TCM) to the classification of TCM constitution.

articleTitle: WiPass: CSI-based Keystroke Recognition for Numerical Keypad of Smartphones
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Nowadays, smartphones are everywhere. They play an indispensable role in our lives and makes people convenient to communicate, pay, socialize, etc. However, they also bring a lot of security and privacy risks. Keystroke operations of numeric keypad are often required when users input password to perform mobile payment or input other privacy-sensitive information. Different keystrokes may cause different finger movements that will bring different interference to WiFi signal, which may be reflected by channel state information (CSI). In this paper, we propose WiPass, a password-keystroke recognition system for numerical keypad input on smartphones, which especially occurs frequently in mobile payment APPs. Based on only a public WiFi hotspot deployed in the victim payment scenario, WiPass would extracts and analyzes the CSI data generated by the password-keystroke operation of the smartphone user, and infers the user's payment password by comparing the CSI waveforms of different keystrokes. We implemented the WiPass system by using COTS WiFi AP devices and smartphones. The average keystroke segmentation accuracy was 80.45%, and the average keystroke recognition accuracy was 74.24%.

articleTitle: China's Urban Eco-Efficiency and its Spatial Relationship with Participatory Governance
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper uses the SBM-Undesirable model to measure the urban eco-efficiency in China and analyzes the trends from the view of resource-based and non-resource-based cities. Through the panel data of 273 prefecture-level cities in China, the spatial and Durbin model is used to deeply explore the influencing factors of urban eco-efficiency from the perspective of participatory governance. The results show that urban eco-efficiency has strong spatial differentiation and spatial correlation. The eco-efficiency of non-resource-based and renewable cities is more efficient while declining cities need to be improved. There is a trend that high-efficiency areas drive the progress of low-efficiency areas. Furthermore, participatory governance can significantly improve the urban eco-efficiency, in which cooperative motivation, government innovation ability, and citizen participation quality have a positive impact on urban eco-efficiency, while government over-intervention inhibits the growth of efficiency. The research clarifies the relationship between participatory governance and urban eco-efficiency, and its conclusion provides an important reference for China's ecological construction and sustainable urban development.

articleTitle: An Advanced Real-Time Synchronized Goertzel algorithm in Smart Power Meter
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of complicated calculation and poor real-time performance in measuring the electrical parameters of the traditional smart meter, this paper proposed a real-time Synchronized Goertzel algorithm which can be well applied in the smart meter (SM) system. By processing the voltage and current data collected from the grid terminal, the algorithm can obtain the information of frequency, energy and waveform with time labels, so as to realize low cost, efficient measurement and transmission of grid monitoring information in the Internet of Things (IoT). At the same time, the algorithm can adapt to the change of power grid frequency, calculate the RMS values of voltage and current with high accuracy, avoiding the problem of inaccurate energy evaluation caused by the fixed frequency constant of smart meter. Furthermore, the efficacy of the proposed algorithm has been evaluated by theoretical calculation and validation in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Intelligence in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The energy internet is a cyber-physical system (CPS) to connect directly and indirectly the devices of information, communication, control, and protection to effectively generate, transmit, use, and store various energy by merging new technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, and blockchain, etc. Recently, AI technology has become increasingly popular in many research and industrial fields because it can perform tasks well. However, applying AI technologies to energy internet is relatively less. Therefore, in this paper, the potential applications of AI technologies in the energy internet will be reviewed and discussed. In section II and section III, the operating and monitoring of power systems are the main parts to discuss. Firstly, applying AI technologies to the operation of control, optimization, and decision-making in power systems will be detailed in section II from three aspects such as existing problems, potential demands, and valuable improvement. Secondly, in section III, detecting faults and analyzing stability by energy internet monitoring is mainly discussed. Finally, in section IV, it shows an example using the neural network to analyze the power flow of a standard IEEE 39 nodes power system compared with traditional Newton-Raphson method.

articleTitle: EFSSD: An Enhanced Fusion SSD with Feature Fusion and Visual Object Association Method
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The single-shot multibox detector (SSD) is a landmark work in object detection field that achieves excellent performance in target detection. In this paper, an accurate single-stage object detector, namely enhanced fusion SSD (EFSSD) is proposed for the object detection problems. The residual network is introduced to extract deeper feature information. Moreover, we use the feature fusion method to fuse feature maps of different layers. To further detect small objects, a visual object association method is developed, which makes full use of relationships between targets instead of the feature of the target itself. To evaluate the proposed EFSSD, it was trained on PASCAL VOC2007 and PASCAL VOC2012 training datasets and tested on the PASCAL VOC2007 test dataset. For 300 × 300 input, EFSSD achieves 80.1 % and 53 frames per second (FPS) and EFSSD achieves 83.7% and 17.1 FPS for 512 × 512 input. The above experimental performances show that EFSSD achieves higher accuracy comparing with SSD and other advanced detectors.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Integrated Natural Gas and Electricity Systems with Unit Commitment
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The joint operation of natural gas system and power system is an important direction of energy system integration. In this paper, the unit combination modeling method of integrated gas-electric energy system is studied, and the operation constraints such as output, climbing and duration considering unit startup and shutdown state are established. The matrix balance model of power system and natural gas system is established. Based on the generation transfer distribution factor, the tie line security constraints are proposed, and the simplified method of gas electric coupling model of gas turbine based on the piecewise linearization method is proposed. Finally, 6-node power system and 6-node natural gas system are used to build an integrated gas electric energy system. Taking the economic cost optimization as the optimization goal, it is verified that the unit combination constraint in this paper can effectively optimize the unit operation dispatching in the combined system.

Author Keywords: integrated natural gas and electricity system

articleTitle: Evaluation methods on charging safety for EV power battery
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The charging safety of electric vehicles is increasingly important while the number of electric vehicles swelling. Power battery's charging safety assess result is dominating in the whole charging safety solution. This paper firstly introduces the present situation of charging safety, and then describes the complex structure model and analyze the charging safety mechanism of power battery. After that, all kinds of safety evaluation parameters and methods about power battery are summarized to reveal the advantages, disadvantages and accuracy of each other. Finally, the shortcomings of the current evaluation methods about charging safety are discussed and then the direction of improvement is indicated.

articleTitle: Research on Complexity of Traffic Factors Based on EEG Data
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Scientifically measuring the complexity of traffic factors and accurately assessing the driver's mental load can help reduce driving risks and road accidents. In order to describe the complexity of traffic factors objectively and quantitatively, the comparison experiment of traffic factors with different complexity are carried out as the research basis. In this paper, the driver's electroencephalogram (EEG) signals obtained from the experiment are analyzed, and a complexity quantization method for traffic factors based on the difference between the predicted value and the actual value of the a wave power spectral density in the parietal lobe of EEG is determined. Finally, based on the quantitative method, the complexity of pedestrian crossing, vehicle speed changing and vehicle lane changing are compared objectively and quantitatively in this paper.

Author Keywords: power spectral density of a wave in the parietal lobe

articleTitle: Application and Future of Modern Energy Internet Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The emergence of deep learning is undoubtedly a landmark breakthrough in artificial intelligence, and the emergence of this technology makes it possible for us to realize the real smart grid. A major challenge currently facing deep learning technology is the requirement of enough training samples to ensure the accuracy of results of the learning. But for the current power grid, training data can be obtained because a lot of real time data is collected to maintain the stability of its operation. With the deep learning technology, there is no doubt that these data can be utilized to realize the intelligent operation of the power grid. First, this paper gives a brief introduction to the current artificial intelligence, followed by the introduction of deep learning technology. Some potential applications of the deep learning in the daily operation of the power grid are proposed. And in the end, there is a brief description of some of the features that future smart grids should have.

articleTitle: Internet of Mind with General Intelligent Dispatch in Electrical Industrial: The Concept, Framework, Technology, and Future
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes the concept of general intelligent dispatch, which is a novel framework of electrical power dispatch based on modern artificial intelligence (AI). The general intelligent dispatch system is based on knowledge automation, parallel system, ACP method, and fully integrated with cutting-edge technologies such as parallel deep learning, parallel dynamics programming. The general intelligent dispatch system is devised to be a comprehensive framework that can support the applications of various modern AI technologies in electrical power dispatch. General intelligent dispatch can accommodate the rapid development of the future smart grid, especially the extensive implementation of distributed energy resources and renewable energy. General intelligent dispatch also provides the practical technical path and framework for the future smart power dispatch services to achieve a higher level of automation and intelligence. Based on the general intelligent dispatch concept, this paper addresses power grid situational awareness, which provides an example for the applications of general intelligent dispatch.

articleTitle: Neural Network Modeling Based on Lead Elements Approximation to $\mathrm{s}^{\alpha}$ and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To obtain a dynamic model with good generalization and a high accuracy, a new neural network modeling method with fractional filters is proposed. The filter contains the operator <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{s}^{\alpha}$</tex> derived from the time domain, but the geometric and physical meaning of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{s}^{\alpha}$</tex> is not clear and the calculation speed is slow. In the present study, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{s}^{\alpha}$</tex> is deduced from the frequency domain (sine and cosine functions) to make it easier to understand, and the cascade leading elements (CL) are used to approximate <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{s}^{\alpha}$</tex> reasonably, which makes the calculation speed of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{s}^{\alpha}$</tex> faster than other methods. A particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used in neural network modeling and its application (PID tuning). The simulation results show that the CL algorithm realizes good time savings, while the model has good generalization and high accuracy. It can be applied to a wide variety of projects.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Security Defense Methods of Power CPS
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Smart Grid is the deep interactive fusion of power information system and physical system under the background of modern energy interconnection. Compared with the traditional power grid, its performance has been greatly improved. The essence of smart grid is the application of cyber physical system (CPS) in power industry, which is called power CPS. In view of the cyber security risk caused by the integration of the two systems in power CPS, which may cause the system to suffer complex and severe cascading failures and blackouts, it is of great significance to study the power CPS modeling and security defense based on the integration of the two networks. Different things have different classification methods from different angles. This paper summarizes the main research and analysis methods of power CPS modeling and security defense protection at home and abroad, and puts forward the future development direction, hoping to provide reference for the relevant researchers.

articleTitle: Research and Performance Analysis of Single Intersection Online Q-Iearning Model Based on Queue Length Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of intersection phase queue equilibrium, this paper uses reinforcement learning theory to establish online Q-Iearning model with the difference of intersection queue length as the optimization goal. At the same time, in order to accelerate the convergence speed and avoid the dimension disaster, the state space and reward function are reconstructed, and the prior knowledge is introduced to judge to improve the robustness of the model. The second development of VISSIM is carried out by using MATLAB to establish online simulation platform and carry out experimental analysis. The experimental results show that taking the difference of queue length as the optimization objective can improve the balance of queue length in all directions; and the selection of parameters and applicability of the model are analyzed. The results show that the online Q-Iearning model established in this paper has the learning ability and faster calculation speed, and the convergence of the model is affected by the periodic value and the number of optional behaviors.

articleTitle: Research on Nansan Islands Beach Response to Strong Typhoon Mangkhut
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The spatiotemporal dynamics of the beach under extreme wave conditions is essential for beach erosion mechanism. The mechanism is helpful to coastal engineering management, resource utilization, disaster prevention, and mitigation. Before and after the landfall of strong Typhoon Mangkhut, the beach profile survey and beach surface sediment sampling were carried out at the beach of Nansan Island, Zhanjiang, China. By comparing the beach profile changes and sediment dynamic characteristics before and after the landfall of Mangkhut, we got the following results: (1) Nansan Island Beach responded to extreme dynamic conditions rapidly. During the whole response-recovery stage, sediments in the supratidal zone and the sand bars in the subtidal zone interact with each other. The intertidal zone is relatively stable without noticeable erosion/accretion changes. (2) Influenced by Typhoon Mangkhut, surface sediments on the beach became finer and better sorted. In the recovery stage, sediments were redistributed along the beach surface. (3) The recovery process of the supratidal zone was relatively independent. In the process of recovery, sediments on the beach surface were redistributed during transporting through the intertidal zone, which affected the recovery rate of the subtidal zone.

articleTitle: A new method of freeway vehicle trajectory reconstruction based-on minimum speed compensation
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the purpose of improving the accuracy and effectiveness of the reconstructed trajectory, a new travel time prediction-based vehicle trajectory reconstruction method is developed in this paper. Firstly, a feature matching-based travel time prediction is presented, which provides the predicted travel time as the basis parameters of the trajectory reconstruction method. Then, a trajectory reconstruction algorithm based on minimum speed compensation is proposed, which takes predicted travel time of freeway segments as transition parameter and the real travel time as constraint. Finally, the Frechet distance evaluation is used to assess the similarity between the reconstructed trajectory and the other two data source-based trajectory. The results show that the mean relative errors of the three data sources-based (detector data, bayonet data and reconstructed trajectory data) average speed of road network are 8.2%, 4.07% and 2.47% respectively, which means the reconstructed vehicle trajectory is effective and which can more effectively reflect the real running state of the road network.

articleTitle: A Fusion Approach for Rotating Machinery Fault Diagnosis Using Double Sample K-S Inspection and Modified D-S Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to determine the basic probability distribution value in the evidence fusion of petrochemical rotary unit fault signals, this paper proposes a dimensionless index-based hybrid approach using the two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) test. This method decreases the effect of the interference from the fault characteristic sensitivity and operating conditions through the dimensionless index's calculation. It can also find out the evidence needed for fusion basic probability assignment values by the two sample K-S test. Finally, it conducts evidence fusion using a modified D-S algorithm. The advantage of the proposed method that makes it superior to other methods is that it can deal with fuzzy, incomplete or accurate data. Therefore, the input signals of petrochemical rotary machinery equipment and sensor equipment can be processed directly. In this paper, experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method, so the decision risk can be reduced.

articleTitle: Finite-time Online Sensor Power Scheduling for Remote State Estimation with Communication Energy Constraint
publicationTitle: 2020 35th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We build an online algorithm for a WSN (Wire-less Sensor Network) with a feedback loop to reduce the estimation error over a finite time horizon under a limited energy budget. Our algorithm decides to send a high or low power signal at the current time step, and due to the energy limit, the sensor can only send a limited number of high power signals. The high power signal guarantees a successful transmission and the low power signal arrives at the estimator with a certain packet drop rate. When there is no feedback, the previous study has shown the optimal scheduling should be as close to a uniform distribution as possible. However, with the feedback information, the sensor knows whether the low power signal has arrived successfully at the remote estimator. The successfully arrived low power signals can thus be regarded as high power signals, so we can improve the state estimation accuracy of the optimal offline sensor scheduling by these bonus high power signals. Therefore our algorithm re-schedules the sensor scheduling strategy at every time step. According to the feedback information our algorithm chooses to send a high or low power signal and this choice makes full use of the feedback information and reduces the expected error covariance over the remaining time horizon. Finally, the Matlab simulation shows that our algorithm improves the performance of the estimation.
